name: Water
lore: Not merely liquid, but the collective memory of all things that have dissolved since the dawn of time.
usage: Essential for binding volatile spirits; the only substance capable of diluting the bitterness of forbidden truths.

name: Fire
lore: The hunger that refuses to be sated. It does not 'create'—it merely transitions matter from form to ash.
usage: Required for extraction processes. Keep it contained, or it will attempt to extract the soul from the beaker.

name: Earth
lore: The slow, slumbering giant. It contains the echoes of everything that has ever fallen upon it.
usage: The ultimate stabilizing agent. When your mixture threatens to tear reality apart, bury it in Earth.

name: Air
lore: The thin veil between sanity and delirium. It carries the voices of those who have passed into the slipstream.
usage: Used to refine textures and accelerate the onset of reactions. Often used by seers to clear their own minds.

name: Steam
lore: The ghost of a transition. It is what remains when Fire has finished its work with Water.
usage: Used to distill pure essences from coarse matter.
